phases.claim_under_test: A generic adversarial instruction is sufficient to govern creative publication safely.
challenge_method: Searched repository-visible evidence for an existing team-specific protocol.
Compared publication needs against current fail-closed deployment and shared-state constraints.
findings: No repository-visible Independent Creative Web Team protocol was found by targeted code search.
A generic instruction does not define publication-specific claim boundaries, protected surfaces, or evidence requirements.
Creative success, deployment success, accessibility, privacy, and physical-device behavior can be falsely collapsed into one claim.
repairs: Added fail-closed publication criteria and explicit protected surfaces.
remaining_uncertainty: Repository code-search coverage may not prove absolute absence of similarly named protocols.
No specific creative release candidate was available for surface-level testing in this run.
evidence_required_before_publication: Exact-commit or immutable-artifact evidence for technical claims.
Accessibility, privacy, performance, interaction, and rollback evidence appropriate to the release.

phases.claim_under_test: The implemented protocol covers the requested challenge classes without enabling unsafe destabilization.
challenge_method: Reviewed the committed protocol against contradiction, drift, assumptions, evidence, duplication, edge cases, misuse, rollback, and counterexample requirements.
Tested the language against unsafe interpretations involving automations, production, DNS, credentials, and user data.
findings: The protocol includes all requested challenge classes.
Unsafe experiments are explicitly excluded and reversible isolation is required.
The first implementation needed a precise distinction between build, deployment identity, route, interaction, accessibility, performance, privacy, and device claims; this distinction is now included.
repairs: Defined permitted and prohibited failure experiments.
Added mandatory significant-challenge records and publication gates.
remaining_uncertainty: The protocol is documentary and not yet enforced by an executable schema validator.
No negative-control fixture has yet demonstrated machine rejection of an incomplete phase record.

phases.claim_under_test: The adversarial protocol exists immutably on preview and is ready to govern future creative work.
challenge_method: Fetched the file by exact commit SHA rather than branch alias.
Inspected the exact-commit content for protected surfaces, three checkpoints, evidence rules, rollback, and fail-closed publication criteria.
Avoided treating repository commit success as deployment or publication success.
findings: The file is retrievable at exact commit a6e0b5011d145a4725deaf5bfc5a9e6b712d59bd.
No application surface, production deployment, automation schedule, or shared state was modified.
No preview deployment claim can be made from repository evidence alone.
repairs: Recorded commit-bound evidence and bounded the verification claim to repository presence.
Blocked publication and deployment claims until separate evidence exists.
remaining_uncertainty: No commit-matched Vercel preview or browser/device verification was attempted because this was operations-only work and provider capacity remains documented as blocked.
evidence_required_before_publication: Exact-commit preview identity and READY state.
Required accessibility, mobile, performance, privacy, no-autoplay, interaction, and rollback checks.

next_falsifiable_step: Add a machine-checkable phase-record schema and prove it accepts one complete fixture while rejecting missing rollback, missing evidence boundary, unsafe experiment scope, and unsupported publication claims.
